about_the_game:
Owning the DLC allows you to invite friends to play Misty Grove caves with you, even if they don’t own the DLC. Your friends will also be able to unlock Misty Grove’s exclusive mutations and keep them in their game, even if they never purchase the DLC themselves!

What’s included:

10 brand new Mutations

Unlock new and exciting mutations for even more chaotic Gremlin powers! Use the notorious Mega Belch to deal with large crowds of enemies, or fly right through them with the Dash Fart! 

Misty Grove Cave Biome

Explore the mysterious caves of the Misty Grove, shrouded in thick fog and lush, damp vegetation. These caves will put your inner exploration gremlin to the test!

Flying Critters

You’ll encounter two types of these bat-like flying creatures all across the Misty Grove. 

The friendly ones are playful and curious. They’ll follow you around and be attracted by light sources. Consuming them will replenish your health!
But beware of their sinister siblings. Lurking in the darker corners of the Misty Grove, these predators hunt in large packs. Unlike their light-loving kin, they avoid brightness at all costs. Stay close to a light source if you want to stay safe.

Light Flowers

This unique plant thrives throughout the Misty Grove. Its luminous fruits act like natural lanterns, casting a strong glow. Carry them to light your way, toss them to illuminate hard-to-reach areas, or consume them to shine brightly as a glowing Gremlin.

Geysers

Steam activity runs deep beneath the Misty Grove, erupting in natural geysers that can be both a blessing and a curse. Use their powerful updrafts to reach higher ground or to disrupt enemy wildlife. But stay alert, careless Gremlins will find themselves thrown off walls by an unexpected burst!

Wobbly Shrooms

This towering plant thrives in the open spaces of the Misty Grove. Its broad top can support your weight, but balancing isn’t easy. Losing your footing might lead to some unexpected consequences!

Bomb Spitter

This giant plant blocks your path and challenges your wits in a boss encounter. Dodge its explosive projectiles and take it down before you go up in flames. But watch your step, its many growing offspring are just as dangerous!

short_description: Expand your adventures with this optional add-on for Mother Machine (base game required). This expansion introduces the Misty Grove cave type, a mysterious network of tunnels shrouded in thick fog and lush, damp vegetation. Put your inner exploration gremlin to the test!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
